result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the bottom navigation overlaps the feed content.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is cut off on the right: a partial extra category pill is visible with no comfortable end padding, making the carousel look clipped by the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing padding to the horizontal list and ensure partially visible items are intentionally sized/positioned, or avoid showing a clipped pill.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel is visibly truncated at the right edge. The third restaurant card and its title/details are cut off, with no right inset.
issues.suggestion: Apply horizontal carousel padding matching the left inset, and ensure card widths/gaps leave an intentional partial-card preview or fully fit the visible cards.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the scrolling restaurant feed; the next popular card is hidden beneath the navigation area instead of the content ending above it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar height plus safe-area inset so all cards can scroll fully above the fixed navigation.
